title: Permission
description: One capability over one resource kind. A discriminated union tagged by "resource-kind", composed onto the access-grant base.

order-permission.title: Order permission
order-permission.description: Acting on orders held by the shop product.

actions.description: What the holder may do to an order in range.

order-range.description: Which orders are in range: the principal's own, the tenant's, or every order.

requires-multi-factor.description: When true, a single-factor session is refused even if the grant matches.

ledger-permission.title: Ledger permission
ledger-permission.description: Acting on double-entry legs held by the billing product.

actions.description: "correct" posts compensating legs; nothing in this catalog can edit one.

account-prefix.description: Chart-of-accounts prefix the grant is confined to. Empty string is not permitted; omit for all accounts.

requires-multi-factor.description: Defaults true here — no single-factor session touches the ledger.

catalog-permission.title: Catalog permission
catalog-permission.description: Acting on sellable items and their prices.

actions.description: "publish" makes a draft item visible to customers.

sku-pattern.description: Glob over SKUs the grant covers, e.g. "apparel-*". Omit for the whole catalog.

account-permission.title: Account permission
account-permission.description: Acting on identity's own accounts — the grants that widen other grants.

actions.description: "grant-role" is the reflexive one: it widens what other principals may do.

requires-multi-factor.description: Defaults true — administration of identity is never single-factor.
